correctness.rationale: The critical values of the four-lap M-map are 0,1 and v(p)=(4p−1)/(4p²). Requiring v(p) to belong to the immediate turning-point partition {0,p,1/2,1−p,1} produces exactly three interior roots of explicit cubics/quadratic, plus the two endpoints. Their Markov matrices follow from the four monotone arms and yield exact path-based lap counts, rational generating functions and PF growth factors 2+sqrt(2),3,1+sqrt(3); at p=1/4,1/2 each arm is full, giving 4^n and 2^n. Independent symbolic expansion checked all critical equations, matrices, characteristic polynomials and recurrence coefficients for n<=8; the full all-n derivation is Markov path counting plus classical entropy-lap growth, not finite numerical extrapolation.
